decisions.decision: Retain the cbXRP/USDC Morpho market as a candidate market, not a verified Coinbase retail loan book.
reason: Coinbase confirms XRP eligibility and Morpho/Base integration but does not publish the exact market ID
Coinbase loan-health documentation says LLTV varies by market and includes 62.5%, 77% and 86% examples, so 62.5% is not inherently contradictory
permissionless market positions above Coinbase's $100,000 retail cap show the displayed market is broader than the retail product
required_verification: query exact market config and state at one Base block
read oracle round and last update at same block
enumerate all positions and liquidation events from Base logs
reconcile cbXRP totalSupply, collateral transfers and reserve addresses

decisions.decision: Represent Coinbase-Circle as a direct distribution, revenue-sharing and equity-investment relationship; do not treat it as exclusive.
reason: Coinbase renewed its Circle arrangement on same terms and reports all-time-high USDC balances
Circle discloses formula-based Coinbase allocations and $324.6M Q2/$655.3M H1 distribution costs
Coinbase listed RLUSD and Circle also signed a five-year USDC distribution agreement with Binance
required_verification: capture Circle Q3 2026 results on November 4
separate USDC balances, reserve income, distribution cost and Coinbase stablecoin revenue
track Binance and Coinbase USDC platform balances separately

decisions.decision: Classify cbXRP minting and Morpho USDC borrowing as wrapper/collateral/credit activity, not fresh XRP spot demand.
reason: Coinbase says cbXRP is backed 1:1 and underlying XRP is not sold or utilized by Coinbase
Morpho market is permissionless and exact product mapping is not public
USDC debt is borrowed credit, not net external cash flow into XRP
required_verification: trace borrowed USDC destinations without inferring purchase intent

decisions.decision: Classify SBI Remit's Philippines/Vietnam/Indonesia corridor as confirmed XRP bridge use, with economic scale unknown.
reason: SBI's official 2023 release states SBI VC Trade sends XRP in real time and Tranglo pays beneficiaries in local currency
required_verification: obtain public volume/transaction metrics if published
measure XRP transfer size, holding duration and counterparties where public
distinguish transient bridge turnover from net XRP inventory

decisions.decision: Keep Tokyo SBIC separate from SBI Holdings and SBI Group.
reason: Tokyo SBIC's official FAQ identifies a distinct policy-implementation corporation
ChatGPT course was training for investee companies only
required_verification: continue exact-phrase search without inferring corporate affiliation

decisions.decision: Model Circle Arc as a parallel stablecoin infrastructure rail with both competitive and complementary hypotheses versus XRPL.
reason: Arc uses USDC as gas and includes SBI, Coinbase and Morpho participation
Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD are also available on XRPL
required_verification: compare actual settlement, credit, liquidity and institutional usage across Arc and XRPL

decisions.decision: Admit none of these new observations as prediction features yet.
reason: several observations are quarterly snapshots, secondary market aggregates or company-reported disclosures; point-in-time synchronized series and raw onchain reconciliation are incomplete
required_verification: build timestamped history, source independence tags, leakage-safe features and walk-forward tests
